title: Free LRT-1 rides on Nov. 9, 11, 13 for ASEAN Summit
summary: Free rides will be available at 25 LRT-1 stations, from Fernando Poe Jr. (FPJ) Station in Quezon City to Dr. Santos Station in Parañaque City, and vice versa, from 7 to 9 a.m. and 5 to 7 p.m.
